goal: Let node operators designate specific peers for high-bandwidth compact block relay
Ensures low-latency peering links announce blocks immediately without waiting for automatic rotation
reviewability: Ready to review with no blocking changes or pending author rework
agreement: Concept approval for allowing explicit operator overrides of the compact block peer cap (jeanpablojp)
Agrees reusing the existing addnode option makes more sense than introducing a dedicated flag (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it adds an opt-in feature useful mainly for multi-site setups and private peering links
Benefits specialized node operators who have out-of-band knowledge of their network topology
Does not fix an active bug or affect general compact block relay for typical nodes
